body_html:
The Loover High Back Synchro Tilter is ergonomic seating that does the thinking for you. Its weight-sensing synchro-tilt automatically tunes recline tension to each person who sits in it, while a breathable high-back mesh and height-adjustable live lumbar support keep executives and full-shift task workers comfortable from the first meeting to the last. Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group, it brings genuine ergonomic engineering to private offices, boardrooms, and institutional workspaces alike.

Features

  • Weight-sensing synchro-tilt automatically adjusts recline tension to the user's weight — no manual dial required
  • Height-adjustable live lumbar support via a concealed ratchet system
  • Side-activated sliding seat-depth adjustment for the right thigh support
  • G5 lockable armcaps adjust for height, depth, and width
  • Soft Descent pneumatic lift lowers the seat smoothly and gently
  • Breathable high-back Vue mesh, available in 24 colours
  • Seat upholstered in fabric, vinyl, or leather, with optional memory foam
  • Five-star fiberglass-reinforced nylon base on smooth-rolling casters

Specifications

Overall dimensions 25.5"W x 25"D x 42"H. Tested to exceed ANSI/BIFMA standards and backed by Global's commercial seating warranty — limited lifetime on the frame, base and mechanism, with five years on upholstery, foam and mesh. A Canadian-made ergonomic office chair from Global Furniture Group.

Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Canadian dealer (since 1964) at 296 George St N, Peterborough ON, and an OECM-eligible supplier — Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote below or call 1-800-835-9565 for volume pricing and upholstery selection.
